packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Output coalescing
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Groups the model's streamed output so saving it never slows the reading.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Suggested reply
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Produces the agent's optional suggestion for your next reply, within the same answer.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Task boundaries
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Pauses a task only at safe points, never in the middle of a tool action.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Parallel tool calls
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Splits an agent's tool calls into groups that can safely run at the same time, keeping the results in order.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Tool-call block
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Runs a batch of the model's tool calls, records each result in order, and routes any waits.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Run one tool call
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Carries out a single tool call under the rules that keep it safe to replay after a crash, and marks an action that did not return as failed or uncertain.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Tool exposure
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Chooses, once per run, which tools the model may use, and freezes that choice.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Tool guardrails
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Blocks an agent from repeating a pointless read or the same action too many times.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Call bookkeeping
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Keeps the record of tool calls complete and cancels proposals that were superseded.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: The agent loop
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: The main loop of a run: it alternates between asking the model and carrying out the tools it calls.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Uncertain-outcome line
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Adds one honest line to the reply when an owner request was left with an uncertain result.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Card parsing
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Finds and compiles the generated-UI pieces inside a model's reply while the rest of the text keeps streaming.

packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.name: Workspace file move
packages/agent-runtime/src/lonora_agent/.description: Copies each agent's older analysis files into its home in the owner's workspace, once, before the old store is removed.
